An '''orbital gun platform''' was any [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] or fortification that could launch an attack from [[Realspace/Legends|space]] upon the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] it orbited.

==History==
In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] orbital gun platforms were in space around [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
